verdict.rationale: Snyk's own marketing says its context-aware risk scoring weighs the reachability of vulnerable code in affected packages, and its plans list risk-based prioritization. That is a direct first-party claim, but it is one marketing line with no documentation of how reachability works for open-source dependency alerts or how to filter or sort by it. Missing for 10: Snyk Open Source docs describing reachability analysis, supported languages/ecosystems, a documented way to filter or sort dependency issues by reachable status, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can prioritize dependency alerts by whether the vulnerable code is actually reachable from my code

citations.quote: DeepCode AI supports Snyk’s context-aware risk scoring, assessing the popularity of the affected package and the reachability of vulnerable code, all while monitoring the maturity of available exploits.
